what: Hovering a link swells its letters from the front in .035s steps to 1.14x, tilts them randomly ±7°, and rings them with a .4px outline in the text color (.38s back.out(1.8)) so they look bolder, then each letter that has popped settles back in place over .5s power2.out — a wave of letters bouncing along the line. On release the remaining letters return in .018s steps over .35s

options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to split (if empty, the whole text of the attached element — svg·img are skipped)
options.rim: When off, no outline is added around the letters (which makes them look bolder)

from.where: shared.js footer links · contact modal email — original initTwo26FooterAnimation·initTwo26ContactModal footer-link-char·contact-email-char

note: On devices without hover, no splitting. On release, the original text is restored
